title: The localized slice equivalence has the Hom nerve formula
statement: Let C,E be small categories, J,K Grothendieck topologies, K subcanonical, F:E→Sh(J) fully faithful, and N:Sh(J)≃Sh(K) a specified equivalence whose underlying presheaf is naturally Hom(F(-),-). For every Z∈E, there is an equivalence Over(FZ)≃Sh(K.over Z) whose underlying presheaf at B→FZ sends A→Z to Hom over FZ from FA→FZ to B→FZ. No subterminal, covering or finite-limit hypothesis is needed. The localized site and sheaf categories are those of [def-pur-localized-ringed-site, def-weil-pbc-topos].

source.place: Tags 00Y1, 04GZ and 03EH; sites-modules.tex Tags 03CR and 04IE. Auxiliary extraction of the corresponding steps of lem-sp-binary-cover-site-presentation.

proof.text: Use the extension/fibre equivalence of [lem-weil-pbc-localized-sheaves-over-representable] and the equivalence induced by N on Over categories. Full faithfulness of F and the nerve formula give N(FZ)≅hZ. Compose the three equivalences.

A section of the fibre is a section s of N(B) with N(p)s equal to the structure map A→Z under N(FZ)≅hZ. The nerve bijection and its naturality turn this equation into p∘b=F(A→Z). Send s to that arrow b over FZ; the inverse sends b through the inverse nerve bijection. The two inverse equations are the nerve isomorphism equations. Precomposition and postcomposition prove both naturalities.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_binaryPresentationSliceNerve
    {C E : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory E]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology E} [K.Subcanonical]
    (F : E ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u)) [F.Full] [F.Faithful]
    (N : Sheaf J (Type u) ≌ Sheaf K (Type u))
    (hN : N.functor ⋙ sheafToPresheaf K (Type u) ≅ sheafSubcategoryNerve F) (Z : E) :
    ∃ e : Over (F.obj Z) ≌ Sheaf (K.over Z) (Type u),
      Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (K.over Z) (Type u) ≅
        yoneda ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringLeft (Over Z)ᵒᵖ
          (Over (F.obj Z))ᵒᵖ (Type u)).obj (Over.post F).op)
